Duration::sub¶

Back to Duration API Reference

Signature¶

Duration Duration::operator-(const Duration& other) const;
Duration& Duration::operator-=(const Duration& other);

What It Does¶

Duration - Duration combines two elapsed-time values elementwise, broadcasting via the same SeriesIterator machinery every other N-D op in Pluss uses. -= is ordinary compound-assignment sugar around the binary operator — it mutates self in place and returns Duration&, rather than building a new Duration and reassigning.

Parameters¶

other (const Duration&)

The other duration. Broadcasts against self under ordinary N-D rules.

Returns¶

Duration for operator- A new duration holding the elementwise difference.

Duration& for operator-= A reference to the (now-mutated) self.

Examples¶

Example 1. Subtract one duration from another.

auto one_hour = pluss::duration::hours(1);
auto one_day = pluss::duration::days(1);
std::cout << pluss::duration::print(one_day - one_hour);

Output¶

Duration(shape=[], dim=0, numel=1)
0 days 23:00:00.000000000

1 day - 1 h = 23 h.

Example 2. -= mutates self in place and is verified identical to the binary operator it wraps.

auto compound_sub = one_day;
compound_sub -= one_hour;
std::cout << "diff=" << pluss::series::print(compound_sub.total().hours()) << "\n";
std::cout << "matches_binary=" << pluss::series::print(compound_sub.eq(one_day - one_hour));

Output¶

diff=Series(shape=[], strides=[], dtype=float64, platform=cpu, numel=1, contiguous=true)
data=23.0000
matches_binary=Series(shape=[], strides=[], dtype=bool, platform=cpu, numel=1, contiguous=true)
data=true

Notes¶

  • Duration also combines with Timeline: Timeline - Duration and Timeline - Timeline (which itself produces a Duration) both exist, documented on Timeline::sub_duration and Timeline::diff.

  • Subtracting always combines two Durations — there is no Duration - <plain number> overload. To scale a single Duration by a plain count instead, use mul/div.

See Also¶

  • add: the complementary operation.

  • neg: unary negation — a - b and a + (-b) are equivalent.

  • construction: building the operands used here.

  • Timeline::sub_duration: the Timeline-side use of Duration subtraction.
